offering_description.value: BKV is a Denver-based energy company that produces natural gas and natural gas liquids, mainly from the Barnett Shale in Texas and the Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania. It also owns natural gas power generation and develops carbon capture and sequestration projects. It sells to marketers, utilities and power buyers.

primary_products.value: natural gas; natural gas liquids; crude oil condensate; electricity

primary_services.value: carbon capture and sequestration; midstream gathering and processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: gas marketers, utilities, midstream processors, refiners and power purchasers

end_markets.value: energy; power generation; utilities; industrial and petrochemical feedstock

revenue_model.value: product sales: natural gas, NGLs and oil sold at market prices, electricity sold from gas-fired power plant; other: carbon credits and tax credits from carbon capture projects

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates gas wells and gathering assets, selling to marketers and midstream buyers; asset operator: operates gas-fired power generation selling electricity to the grid

geography_served.value: US national: Operations in Pennsylvania (Marcellus) and Texas (Barnett), sales to US markets

specialization.value: related lines: upstream gas production, power generation and carbon capture

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: gas and NGLs sold to marketers, processors and pipelines, power sold into the grid

regulatory_exposure.value: high: oil and gas drilling permits, emissions rules (EPA, state regulators), pipeline and CO2 sequestration well permitting

notes: Power plant and carbon capture details are from memory; some uncertain.
